# WRIA 10 - Rushingwater Creek Alluvial Fan Restoration (#24-1398)

Rushingwater Creek meets the Mowich River at an alluvial fan where cold, thermally stable spring and groundwater flow mixes with the turbulent, glacially turbid mainstem. This project aims to place engineered log jams across that confluence to rebuild instream habitat complexity and connectivity along the resulting thermal gradient, giving rearing juveniles feeding and growth habitat and giving upstream migrating, spawning adults places to hold. This page tracks 360° site documentation across the alluvial fan, providing a "virtual site tour" of the site as the project develops.

Live site: [All tours](https://alex-spsseg.github.io/wria10_rushingwater/tours.html)
